methods.description: Define the cubic-metre unit by its one-metre cube and interpret a count of units.
Compare a familiar object or estimate with a cubic-metre frame and choose an appropriate volume unit.
Estimate rectangular space using metre-sized cubes per layer and layers; check a proposed rough volume.
Explain why area omits the third dimension and choose cubic units.
